lines.text: You're standing in the kitchen, Grandma slices an onion, and bam—you're crying!
Don't worry, you're not sad! The onion is actually defending itself!
Underground, onions don't want hungry moles and worms eating their bulb!
When a knife slices the onion, tiny microscopic cells burst open!
Sulfur compounds mix together to create an invisible cloud of tear gas!
When the gas touches your moist eyes, nerve sensors shout, Warning, irritant detected!
Your tear glands instantly pump a waterfall of fresh saline to wash it away!
Chef trick: Chill your onion in the fridge first to slow down the gas!
